description: A single rendered table (Table 1), presented as a cropped image with no other panels. It is a two-row, four-column grid delimited by a thin rule under the header row. The header row reads, left to right: "Sample", "α", "β", "n" (the Greek letters alpha, beta and a lower-case italic n). The single data row reads: "RD/TD", "1.35", "2", "2". There are no units printed in any cell, no footnotes, no colour coding and no significance markers; the values 1.35, 2 and 2 are printed plain and are fully legible. The table therefore reports the optimised Olson–Cohen (OC) model fitting parameters α, β and n for the RD/TD loading direction of the studied low-density medium manganese steel; only one condition is tabulated, so no comparison across directions is shown within the table itself. Its role in the figure set is to supply the numeric constants that the accompanying OC-model curves and the HEXRD martensite-fraction data depend on. The image contains no axis, no scale bar, no micrograph and no data trend beyond this single parameter set.

observations.observation: The table has four columns headed Sample, α, β, n and contains exactly one data row.
The single tabulated sample/loading condition is labelled 'RD/TD'.
The printed value of α is 1.35.
The printed value of β is 2 and the printed value of n is 2.
No units are printed for α, β or n in the table cells.
The caption titles the table 'Summary of parameters of the OC model in different tensile directions'.
The citing text states that the constants α, β and n are closely related to the shear band formation rate and the stacking fault energy (SFE) of austenite.
The citing text states that martensite nucleation is assumed to occur randomly with a value of n = 2, fixed by reference [61].
The citing text gives the initial austenite fraction FγO as 46.5 vol.% for the OC model.

The citing text states the OC model is first applied to the TD sample and the fitting parameters obtained there are then used to fit the RD sample, with ε_RD = 1.15 ε_TD determined from micro-DIC data (Fig. 12(c) and (d)).
Although the caption says parameters are given for different tensile directions, the table displays only one row (RD/TD) — no separate RD and TD parameter rows are visible.

subfigures.description: Rendered table with header row Sample | α | β | n and a single data row RD/TD | 1.35 | 2 | 2. A horizontal rule separates the header from the data row. All entries are legible.
